About Hamblin Weather

Meet Noah Hamblin

Hey, I’m Noah Hamblin, the meteorologist behind Hamblin Weather! I’ve lived in West Tennessee my whole life and have been fascinated by weather since I was a kid. I graduated from UT Martin in 2026, where I studied meteorology. Sharing forecasts is how I get to do something with that lifelong interest for the communities I call home.

I started Hamblin Weather because I wanted people here to have a forecast that felt like it was made for them. When I look at a map, I see towns I know, roads I drive, and places where people are trying to get to work, make it to a ballgame, or decide what to do about storms coming in after dark. Those are the things I think about when I sit down to make a forecast.

I got started sharing daily forecasts on social media because that was already where a lot of people went to find out what was happening. I built this site to give those updates a home and make it easier to find your county forecast, check radar and satellite, or read an official alert right from your phone.

On a quiet day, I want to help you figure out whether you can get the yard mowed or keep your weekend plans. When storms are possible, I’ll tell you which towns I’m watching, when the weather could reach you, and what I’m still unsure about.

I’m excited to keep building Hamblin Weather, from better daily forecasts and graphics to more live coverage and an app built around the communities I cover. If you’ve ever shared a forecast with a neighbor, left a comment, or checked in before heading out the door, thank you. And if you’re just finding Hamblin Weather, I’m glad you’re here.

The Hamblin Weather Coverage Area

I focus on 14 West Tennessee counties so I can spend more time on details that matter here, like when rain may reach your town or whether storms could affect your drive home. On the Blog, I’ll share what I’m watching and explain why the forecast may change.

  • Carroll
  • Crockett
  • Dyer
  • Fayette
  • Gibson
  • Haywood
  • Henry
  • Lake
  • Lauderdale
  • Madison
  • Obion
  • Shelby
  • Tipton
  • Weakley
